verdicts.reason: A and B look the same: both put the hashtag in a tiny yellow pill that cannot be read, and the symptom list re-wraps out of order ("Shortness of breath Dry cough", "Sore throat Headache") at a few pixels tall, so it is illegible. In both, the doctor illustration is shrunk to a thumbnail with a sliver of white panel behind it, and the yellow CTA is crammed against the right edge. The headline does lead and the banner reads left to right, but no detail separates the two.
